name: Condensate return pumps, hot wells / collection tanks and condensate return lines (pumping vs pressure return;
description: Collect and return hot condensate to the boiler/feedwater system. Where trap inlet pressure cannot overcome return-line backpressure (lift + friction + receiver pressure = TDH), use electric centrifugal/turbine pumps, non-electric steam/air-driven mechanical pumps (SPDs/pump-traps), or ejector-assisted low-NPSH condensate pumps (TLV; Spirax Sarco). Primary source: https://www.tlv.com/steam-info/steam-theory/condensate-recovery/types-of-condensate-recovery
